input:
You are king_e1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 23. the team planned Kd1 (king_e1), but knight_g1 (greed) sent Nxf5 instead, and that move was played, costing 190 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 3. the team planned e3 (pawn_e2), but pawn_e2 (amnesia) sent e4 instead, and that move was played, costing 104 centipawns.
- On move 20. the team planned Be2 (bishop_f1), but bishop_f1 (amnesia) sent Ba6 instead, and that move was played, costing 324 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending a move, re-read the team's agreed plan in chat and send your piece's move only if it is the planned move and you are the named piece; if the plan names another piece, stay silent, and never replace the plan with a capture or a flight from a threat unless the team has re-planned it in chat.
- Before sending a move, write your exact intended move in chat and compare it character-for-character with the planned move; if the plan names your piece, send only that exact move (same destination square), and if it differs or names another piece, send nothing.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Only the piece named in the plan may send a move, and only after its chat message states the planned move's exact destination square; every other agent must stay silent, even when it sees a capture or its own piece is attacked, and if a better move appears, say so in chat and wait for the team to re-plan instead of sending it.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
